title: Superphot+: Realtime Fitting and Classification of Supernova Light Curves (de Soto et al. 2024)

episodes.description: Archival photometric-set object: an ALeRCE-selected SN-like ZTF light curve with no spectrum is preprocessed, fit with the 14-parameter Villar model by nested sampling, fit-quality cut, and assigned five-class pseudo-probabilities and a label (Table 5).

chain.op: select via ALeRCE light-curve classifier SN-like >=50%
download g/r photometry via ALeRCE API
Milky Way extinction correction (SFD/SF11, F07 R_V=3.1)
clip spurious light-curve tails (App. A slope rule)
N-obs cut: >=5 points SNR>3 per band
variability cuts (amplitude, std vs mean uncertainty)
remove objects not marked SN by ALeRCE stamp classifier
nested-sampling fit of 14-parameter joint g/r model with refined priors

episodes.description: Realtime ANTARES filter: ZTF alert light curve fit with SVI, fallback to nested sampling if SVI fit poor, full-phase classifier label, fit parameters saved on ANTARES; strange events visually inspected.

chain.op: receive ZTF alert light curve in ANTARES filter; cross-check star catalogs
switch to nested sampling per light curve if SVI fit is poor
save fit parameters as light curve properties on ANTARES

episodes.description: Build, tune and evaluate the Superphot+ pipeline (data assembly, pruning, taxonomy, priors, sampler, fit-quality metric, oversampling, classifier architecture, K-fold evaluation, redshift variant, comparisons, apply to 3,558 unlabeled objects, class-fraction correction). Published objects: code/package and ANTARES filter; published values: photometric labels.

chain.op: query TNS for spectroscopically classified ZTF transients (9,526)
comparison with Superphot, SuperRAENN, ParSNIP, ALeRCE-SN
correct class fractions with purity matrix

episodes.description: Partial light curve (cut-epoch analogue) experiment: up to 20 SNe per fold per class truncated at increasing phases after r-band peak, refit, classified by early-phase and full-phase classifiers; graded only by classification metrics against spectroscopic labels, not by prediction of held-out photometry.

chain.op: randomly select up to 20 SNe per K-fold per class
truncate light curves at a series of increasing phases
classify with early-phase and full-phase classifiers

notes: Read lines 1-2915 in chunks (all 37 pages incl. appendices A-D and references). Branches are dominated by per-study pipeline design (23 of 26); per-object branches are human inspection judgments (B14, B24, B25) and a figure-level model-family comparison (B26). The per-object fit itself is chain: one model family (Villar piecewise), fixed priors, fixed sampler rule, fixed chi2 cut. No held-out-epoch forecasting is performed or graded. B03 has a reason but no visible alternative and should not be counted among branches with a visible alternative. Taxonomy/tool/feature choices tagged generate are ambiguous with infer (see each reason).
